population_rules.active: topology family begins with rotating_, coupling_scale=0.9, and state_stay_probability in {0.8,0.95}
population_rules.iid_control: topology family begins with rotating_ and state_stay_probability=1/3
population_rules.low_coupling_control: topology family begins with rotating_ and coupling_scale=0.25

comparators.strong_outcome_aware_static: best_fixed_mapping selected per registered cell by geometric cumulative expected-potential risk over all registered seeds

resource_accounting.refresh_delay: a transmitted cache receives the source parameter from k-delay
resource_accounting.environment_steps: identical horizon for every method-seed row

mandatory_gates.G1: all values finite, identical horizons, and no message-budget violation
mandatory_gates.G2: median active one_step_oracle improvement over the strongest registered budgeted comparator is at least 0.10
mandatory_gates.G3: one_step_oracle strictly improves at least 0.60 of active cells
mandatory_gates.G4: weighted_mismatch retains at least 0.70 of the positive oracle gain in median and improves at least 0.60 of active cells
mandatory_gates.G5: maximum weighted_mismatch loss relative to the strongest comparator is at most 0.01 in static and uncoupled controls
mandatory_gates.G6: oracle improvement is positive for every registered nonzero Markov persistence and communication delay in the active population
mandatory_gates.G7: weighted_mismatch selected-edge identity changes at least once in at least 0.50 of active method-seed rows
mandatory_gates.G8: weighted_mismatch aggregate active risk is lower than both largest_mismatch and active_oldest
mandatory_gates.G9: best_fixed_mapping is selected across seeds at cell level, never per seed or trajectory
mandatory_gates.G10: byte-identical clean reproduction after G1-G9 pass

stopping_rule: Any failure among G1-G9 stops reproduction, sampled pilots, formal seeds, standard MARL benchmarks, GPU, and HPC4. No threshold, population, baseline, or seed may be changed after the primary outcome run.
